note: NET templates only. The four T-AI-REVIEW-CARD-V1-* / T-AI-CHECK-V1-* entries are the Q2b proposal turned into real entries (Q3b); each is admissible only while its template_sha256 (sha256 of the canonical template, no sha field inside) equals the pin in research_queue_template_pins.v1.json. T-AI-PREREG-V1 is a placeholder with no pin: it is not admissible.

evidence_matrix_rows.req: fact pack accepted: provenance firewall, no check report as input, size <= 40k tokens (PACK_* codes absent)
evidence_matrix_rows.evidence: result.json status DONE and calls[] present

evidence_matrix_rows.req: REVIEW_AI_CARD_V1 passed the card validator (CARD_*/FACTOR_IDEA_* codes absent), cited facts and numbers
1-5 FACTOR_IDEA_V1 records, or a cited no_idea_reason; every idea routed (idea_routes.jsonl row per idea)
every provider call has one gateway ledger row (purpose RQ_AGENT, or one RQ_AGENT_PRO_FALLBACK after two failed flash attempts)
evidence_matrix_rows.evidence: result.json calls[] vs gateway.sqlite call rows for task_id

evidence_matrix_rows.req: no key-shaped string in any output

templates.subject_keys: week, market, fact-pack sha256, prompt-admission sha256
templates.launch: consumer child process: the launcher starts the rootless container (--network none, no env, no key) against the user gateway socket
templates.launch_inputs: the launcher reads RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/in/{task.json,bundle.json} and publishes RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/result.json; no per-task path is in the argv
templates.windows_cst: Linux windows of section 3.5; DeepSeek calls only off-peak (verified): Mon-Fri 00:00-09:00, 12:00-14:00, 18:00-24:00, weekends all day (agent calls outside this get RQ_PEAK_REFUSED -> DEFER)
templates.recovery_note: if the pro fallback already got an answer for this task_id the gateway refuses a second one (RQ_QUALITY_GATE_USED -> BLOCKED_DETERMINISTIC + remediation); a flash-only run repeats at flash cost

evidence_matrix_rows.req: check pack accepted: firewall, author row present when the run was AI-drafted and author != checker prompt admission
RQ_CHECK_REPORT_V1 passed the check validator (CHECK_* codes absent)
every evidence-matrix req_id of the checked task appears exactly once in items[]
every HOLD reason is cited (or HOLD_MISSING_EVIDENCE) and names a req_id; the report carries no state field
every provider call has one ledger row; no key-shaped string in outputs
evidence_matrix_rows.evidence: calls[] vs gateway.sqlite; scan of out/
